# Day NN — Pattern Name

## Classification and intent
State the GoF category and define the pattern in English.

## Learning objectives and prerequisites
Identify the skills required and expected outcomes.

## Motivation
Describe the recurring problem and forces that make it difficult.

## Naive design
Show the original Java implementation and explain its limitations.

## Structure and participants
Provide a Mermaid class diagram or equivalent and explain each participant and its responsibilities.

## Collaboration
Explain runtime interactions, using a sequence diagram when useful.

## Java implementation
Link to runnable examples, explain construction and execution, and show expected output.

## Applicability and consequences
Explain when to use or avoid the pattern, benefits, costs and alternatives.

## Related patterns and principles
Compare similar patterns and relevant SOLID principles without claiming that a pattern automatically satisfies them.

## Testing
Describe observable behaviour, edge cases and limitations of the tests.

## Practice and interview preparation
Link to exercises, reference solutions and English interview Q&A.

## References and recap
List sources actually consulted and summarise the key design decision.
